perspective:
Ethan’s available information:

- Ethan Mohamud is a plumber. Gary Guo is his long-time close friend; they met in middle school, and Gary works as a doctor.
- Ethan noticed Gary working excessively long hours, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep.
- Ethan was concerned and invited Gary to a weekend retreat for relaxation. Gary declined first, saying he couldn’t because he had too much to do at the hospital.
- During the retreat, Ethan observed Gary acting restless and avoiding discussions about work. Ethan suspected there was more to Gary’s overworking than just professional obligations.
- Ethan confronted Gary, telling him they had been friends since middle school and Gary could tell him anything without judgment. Gary replied that it was complicated and he didn’t want to burden Ethan.
- Gary then opened up to Ethan about pressures from managing a new department and personal challenges he was facing. Ethan felt relief and empathy, and offered to help Gary prioritize tasks and delegate responsibilities. Gary agreed, saying he could use help organizing his schedule to make time for himself.
- Over the following months, Ethan regularly checked in with Gary about his progress and challenges. Ethan saw Gary making efforts to change and felt hopeful and proud. Gary told him things were better, he was less overwhelmed, and he had had time for a movie.
- After a year, Ethan saw that Gary was capable of managing on his own. Ethan decided to step back but told Gary he was always a call away. Gary thanked him, said he couldn’t have done it without Ethan’s support, and felt more in control.
